description: Install shadcn/ui + Zustand + Recharts into frontend-layer and upgrade Conversations tab into the Bridge view
context:
Project: /home/trajan/projects/frontend-layer (Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind 4).

Decisions made:
- Stack: shadcn/ui + Zustand + Recharts (Option D from brainstorm)
- Priority: Bridge View (Option B) — install stack as part of building Bridge, not separate migration
- Approach: Evolve existing Observer app, don't start fresh

Phase 1 — Stack Installation:
- pnpm add zustand recharts
- npx shadcn@latest init (dark theme, match existing CSS vars in globals.css)
- Add shadcn components as needed: command, dialog, tabs, sheet, popover, toast

Phase 2 — Zustand Stores:
- WebSocket store (connection state, messages, agent events — extract from useWebSocket.ts)
- Agent store (roster, status, activity)
- UI store (active tab, sidebar state, modals)

Phase 3 — Bridge View (upgrade existing Conversations.tsx):
- Persistent input bar (always docked at bottom, multi-line with shift+enter)
- Quick-route agent selector bar (emoji buttons above input: 🔬💻💾📋😈)
- Route indicator label ('→ Concierge' etc.)
- Streaming output with expandable cards (one-liner summary, click to expand full thread)
- Command/confirm loop (structured echo on dispatch: task ID, agent, priority, vault path)
- Agent identity rendering (name, avatar emoji, accent color per message)

Reference docs:
- Vision: /home/trajan/vault/Architecture/Future-Frontend-Layer.md
- UX Spec: /home/trajan/vault/Architecture/Future-Frontend-UX-Spec.md
- Design tokens in UX spec section 'Design Tokens'
- Existing WebSocket: src/lib/useWebSocket.ts
- Existing types: src/lib/types.ts
- Gateway protocol: /usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/docs/gateway/protocol.md

Success criteria: Bridge tab renders live agent output with streaming, user can type messages and route to specific agents via quick-route bar, expandable cards work, Zustand manages all state.
success_criteria: 1) shadcn/ui initialized with dark theme matching existing CSS vars. 2) Zustand stores for WS, agents, UI replace scattered useState/useCallback. 3) Conversations tab renamed to Bridge with persistent input bar, quick-route selector, and expandable output cards. 4) pnpm build succeeds. 5) Live agent messages render with identity (emoji + color).
